title: SocketNWChemPot
description: config.ini [SocketNWChemPot] section (SocketNWChemPot). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

host.description: Host where the NWChem client will connect.

port.description: Port for the NWChem client to send data to eOn.

nwchem_settings.description: Path to the user-provided file containing NWChem scientific settings (basis, theory, task, etc.).

unix_socket_path.description: The basename for the UNIX socket file. The full path will be /tmp/ipi_<basename>.

unix_socket_mode.description: If true, use a UNIX domain socket for communication instead of TCP/IP.

mem_in_gb.description: Memory (in GB) to be allocated for the NWChem calculation.

make_template_input.description: If false, the socket input for the right geometry is generated by the user.
